en: The Sūtra of the Noble Six-Syllable Dhāraṇī for Increasing Longevity,
translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śīladharma, Court Rank of Chao-san-dafu, Acting Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial,
and Great Master of the Transmission of the Dharma, under Imperial Decree.
Thus have I heard.
At one time the Buddha was staying at Śrāvastī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍada’s Park.
At that time, the Venerable Ānanda was suffering from a grave illness.
Having known this himself, the Buddha immediately went to that place, spread out his seat, sat down, and addressed Ānanda, saying:
"Listen attentively now; I possess a six-syllable vidyā-mantra of great brilliance."
It can eliminate calamities and increase one's lifespan.
If you uphold it, not only will it benefit yourself,
but it will also cause the fourfold assembly— bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, and upāsikās— to do so as well.
They shall dwell in peace and security for a long night, far removed from all suffering.
Furthermore, Ānanda, these six syllables of the Great Illuminating Dhāraṇī have been [proclaimed] by seventy-seven koṭis of Buddhas.
Furthermore, this was proclaimed by six masters of great majesty and power.
As for these six masters:
the first is the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Samyaksaṃbuddha.
Second, Śakra, Lord of the Devas;
third, Virūḍhaka, King of the Heavenly Kings;
fourth, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, King of the Heavenly Kings.
Vaiśravaṇa, King of the Increase of Wealth;
and Virūpākṣa, King of the Wide Eyes.
Thus these holy ones spoke with one voice in unison.
The dhāraṇī is spoken as follows:
*nandire nandire nanduḷi dumari pañcari kṛñca māndumade svāhā*. The Buddha said to Ānanda:
This six-syllable vidyā-mantra possesses great power and majesty.
Furthermore, if there is anyone who is terrified by the hardships of royal law,
terrified by the hardships of great waters, or terrified by the hardships of great fires;
They are terrified by the calamity of bandit raids; they are terrified by the calamity of hostile enemies;
they are terrified by the calamity of manifold evils; they are terrified by the calamity of battle; they are terrified by the calamity of malevolent planetary influences.
When such various perils threaten the body,
one should single-mindedly recite this great mantra;
it shall protect [the name of] so-and-so and cause them to attain liberation.
Once these words were spoken, all the various afflictions of the assembly were swiftly eliminated.
Furthermore, Ānanda, if there are sentient beings suffering from various pains—
headaches, neckaches, or pain in the eyes, ears, and nose— [they shall be relieved].
Pain in the teeth, tongue, lips, mouth, and cheeks;
pain in the chest, ribs, back, heart, and abdomen;
pain in the waist, hips, and throughout the entire body.
As well as for diarrhea, dysentery, hemorrhoids, fistulas, wind-disorders, jaundice, phlegm, and various other grave and evil illnesses—
by reciting the great vidyā-mantra as before,
the Buddha’s great majestic power causes all the suns, moons, and stellar deities [to be subdued].
The Arhats and Noble Sages utter these words of truth:
"May they provide protection for this disciple, [Name],
extinguishing all calamities and afflictions so that he may attain peace and happiness."
All swords, blades, and poisons, as well as tigers,
wolves, lions, vipers, snakes, scorpions,
and all other malevolent beasts, shall cause them no harm.
They shall not be afflicted by malaria,
nor shall they meet an untimely death; furthermore, none of the various classes of spirits— including the apasmāras,
bhūtas, piśācas, and kumbhāṇḍas— shall have power over them.
They shall all keep far away and dare not cause harm.
Furthermore, Ānanda, if there are sentient beings possessed by ghosts or demons who have not been released for many years and months, [this mantra shall liberate them].
Having empowered a thread with this mantra and tied it around the patient's hand,
Vajrapāṇi, the Great Yakṣa Lord,
by the power of his wrath, shall split the head of the malevolent spirit into seven pieces.
Furthermore, I command the great wise Śāriputra, the one of great supernormal powers Maudgalyāyana,
the precept-keeper Rāhula, and you, Ānanda,
all to come and provide protection so that they may attain peace and security.
If it were not so, Sumeru, the King of Mountains,
would depart from its original place, the great ocean would dry up,
the sun and moon would fall, and the great earth would split asunder.
The Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Samyaksaṃbuddha, speaks no falsehood.
Ānanda, this six-syllable Great Vidya Dhāraṇī possesses unprecedented supernatural power and majestic virtue.
If one rejoices in hearing it,
that person will constantly obtain long life, freedom from illness, and will not be invaded by various evils;
how much more so for those who receive, uphold, read, recite, copy, and make offerings to it!
This is called the method for accomplishing the supreme rite of augmentation.
Having heard this, Ānanda accepted it with faith and practiced accordingly.
The Noble Six-Syllable Great Vidyā Dhāraṇī Sūtra for Increasing Longevity.
